name: Dreame D10 Plus Gen 2
summary: A budget self-emptying robot vacuum that is excellent on hard floors and quiet while it runs, with a 3-year warranty on the robot and base. It is weak on carpet hair and obstacles, its base is bigger than the Tapo's, and Dreame now lists it as discontinued.
idealFor: Buyers who value a longer warranty
pros: Self-emptying into a 4 L bag (Dreame claims up to 90 days)
100% hair and cereal pickup on hard floors in Tom's Guide tests
Quiet while vacuuming: 55.4 dB in TechGearLab tests
3-year warranty on robot and base (battery 1 year)
cons: Discontinued by Dreame: buy only while new stock lasts
Weak on carpet hair (40% on low pile in Tom's Guide tests)
Weak obstacle avoidance: clear cords and socks first

trust.summary: Two independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans hard floors very well and struggles with carpet hair, so confidence is low. Dreame offers a 3-year warranty on the robot and base, but its US site lists no postal address. Safety scores 8/20: no CPSC recalls, but we could not verify a UL/ETL listing or FCC ID. Dreame lists this model under discontinued products.

sources.title: Tom's Guide: Dreame D10 Plus Gen 2 review
sources.note: Ashley Thieme, May 2026, home and lab tests. Hard floor: 100% hair and Rice Krispies; low-pile carpet hair 40%, high-pile 12%; obstacle avoidance hit or miss; short dock cord

sources.title: TechGearLab: Dreame D10 Plus Gen 2 review
sources.note: Rachael Lamore, Apr 2026, bought by GearLab. 55.4 dB vacuuming, 78 dB emptying; 76% carpet, 56% pet hair; navigation 5.3/10; notes Dreame phased it out for the D20 Plus
